is_anopheles.evidence: The study was conducted on bedbugs (Cimex lectularius L.), not Anopheles mosquitoes.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data are reported in this study.

african_field_population.evidence: Bedbugs were collected in Magugu, Tanzania, but no Anopheles mosquito field populations were studied.

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper reports a primary study testing insecticide susceptibility in bedbugs collected from houses in Magugu, Tanzania.

sub_country_location.evidence: Study area is specified as Magugu (4' 00 S, 35' 46 E), Babati district, Manyara region, northern Tanzania.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The exact year of bedbug collection is not explicitly stated in the text.

duplicate_risk.evidence: No indication of sample reuse or dataset overlap.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed because the paper is not eligible.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the susceptibility status of bedbugs (Cimex lectularius) to pyrethroid insecticides in Magugu, Babati district, Tanzania. It is ineligible because it does not study Anopheles mosquitoes or genotype target resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: Does not study Anopheles mosquitoes (studies Cimex lectularius).
Does not report target insecticide resistance markers.
Does not report extractable genotype data.
